name: finds equal and neighboring-bucket matches
input: equal values and negative values within the allowed index window
test:
assert contains_nearby_almost_duplicate([1, 7, 3, 1], 3, 0) is True
assert contains_nearby_almost_duplicate([-6, -2, -4], 1, 2) is True
assert contains_nearby_almost_duplicate([1, 2, 4], 2, 2) is True

name: expires values outside the index window
input: pairs that are close in value but one or more indices too far apart
test:
assert contains_nearby_almost_duplicate([1, 2, 3, 1], 2, 0) is False
assert contains_nearby_almost_duplicate([1, 5, 9, 1, 5, 9], 2, 3) is False
assert contains_nearby_almost_duplicate([1, 1], 0, 0) is False

name: handles a large nonmatching window efficiently
input: increasing integers with zero value gap
